visualization.notes: This network graph shows 52 nodes connected by 50 edges representing relationships in breast cancer trials. Breast cancer is linked most strongly to 'Unknown' with 61 studies, followed by drugs like Cyclophosphamide (11 studies), Trastuzumab and Capecitabine (10 studies each), and Paclitaxel (10 studies). Multiple edges indicate different case-sensitive entries for the same drug (e.g., Trastuzumab and trastuzumab).
visualization.query_interpretation: User wants to see how drugs (interventions) are linked with specific conditions in breast cancer trials. Using a relationship_network type, group_by intervention and condition, so the resulting network can show drugs and associated conditions in breast cancer studies.
